items.title: Carolina Students’ Financial
items.body: Founder and president. Started the effort in April 2025 with a group of 15 students, now a team of 45. We raised equity and deposit pledges and built relationships with state and federal regulators to charter the only student-run financial institution at a public university.

items.title: The Eve Devitt Fund
items.body: Co-founder and CFO of a youth-led nonprofit supporting Idaho trans youth and young human rights organizers.

items.title: Centro Mexicano de Derecho Ambiental
items.body: Full-time policy research in Mexico City on methane abatement, plus a study of case law on the right to a healthy environment.

items.title: Babe Vote
items.body: Board Vice President of a nonpartisan, youth-run voter registration nonprofit in Idaho. Helped register thousands of young voters, trained students at 20+ schools, and coached them to testify at the state legislature.

items.title: Aspen Institute Energy & Environment Program
items.body: Full-time in Washington, D.C. Authored a report on the state of K–12 climate literacy from national survey data and supported the program’s response to federal pre-emption of climate education.

items.title: Green New Deal for Schools
items.body: Organizer with the Sunrise Movement. Wrote climate and equity policy for school districts in Boulder, Evanston, Washington, Berkeley and Northampton.

items.title: Boise School District Board of Trustees
items.body: Elected at 18 as the first student on the board. Helped pass a $300M budget with free breakfast for every student and raises for teachers, rewrote the dress code, and steered landmark clean-energy investments.

items.title: Youth Salmon Protectors
items.body: Directed a coalition of 2,000+ young people across Idaho, Oregon and Washington working for wild salmon recovery on the lower Snake River.
